question: When little-girl Hancock uses her "Mero Mero Mellow" attack and turns you to stone, will other people accuse you of being a ? They won't, will they? Please tell me I'm still safe!! University One Piece Study Circle
answer: Those powers work by leaving people vulnerable whenever they feel that the user is cute or pretty. Well, everyone thinks babies and little kids are cute, right? That's enough for the power to turn you to stone. So if one of the people who got petrified happened to be a lolicon, you would not be able to tell that was the reason why. Nobody will know you're a creep... but have fun getting turned to stone anyway!
